sources.notes: Manufacturer sequence used for the partial board-removal workflow. Optional components are only removed when fitted; this is not a universal teardown of every possible configuration.

sources.locator: Memory type, speed, slot count and maximum capacity

sources.locator: M.2 SSD, SATA drive options, supported form factors and storage combinations
sources.notes: Supported storage configurations, not proof of installed drive population.

sources.locator: M.2, SATA, PCIe and WLAN connector table
sources.notes: Manufacturer connector capability and generation information; no cable path or fitted-device state is implied.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower ports and connectors
sources.locator: Front and rear external ports and connector counts
sources.notes: External I/O support and count; optional module choices vary by order configuration.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower power supply specifications
sources.locator: 260 W PSU variants and AC input characteristics
sources.notes: Two platform PSU variants are listed. The installed PSU manufacturer, Dell part number, efficiency option and revision remain unknown.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower screw-size list
sources.locator: Tower screw-size and quantity table
sources.notes: Documents listed screw types and quantities. Table sum must not be treated as installed screw count in every build.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower heatsink removal
sources.locator: Loosen four captive heatsink screws in the numbered 1–4 sequence
sources.notes: Supports the documented fastener group and screw-release order; no torque value or exact screw coordinates are stated.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower processor removal
sources.locator: Release socket lever and processor cover after heatsink removal
sources.notes: Manufacturer warning about delicate socket contacts; no processor is selected for this family-level package.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower system fan removal
sources.locator: Disconnect intrusion-switch and fan cables; release rubber grommets
sources.notes: Documents fan cable routing through a mounting grommet and the elastomer mounting method. Exact grommet dimensions are not provided.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower power supply removal
sources.locator: Disconnect and unroute cables, release three PSU mounting screws and chassis tab
sources.notes: Manufacturer PSU removal procedure; model-specific cable routing and PSU part number are not captured by the family proxy.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 technical specifications data sheet
sources.locator: Processor options; Tower I/O, storage, dimensions, weight, expansion slots and PSU rows
sources.notes: Combined Tower/SFF/Micro data sheet. Tower-specific chassis/ports/storage/PSU/slots use the Tower column; processor table includes standard and T-suffix options across form factors and must not be read as proof that every CPU fits every form factor.

sources.title: Intel Pentium Gold G5400 Processor Specifications
sources.locator: CPU Specifications: 58 W TDP; GPU Specifications: UHD Graphics 610; Package Specifications: PCG 2015C (65 W)
sources.notes: Intel processor-level TDP and graphics identity. Thermal solution specification is a separate property and must not be conflated with TDP.

sources.title: Intel Pentium Gold G5500 Processor Specifications
sources.locator: CPU Specifications: 54 W TDP; GPU Specifications: UHD Graphics 630; Package Specifications: PCG 2015C (65 W)
sources.notes: Intel processor-level TDP and graphics identity. Thermal solution specification is a separate property and must not be conflated with TDP.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing M.2 SSD
sources.locator: Remove the single screw securing the SSD to the system board; slide SSD out of connector
sources.notes: Procedure is conditional on a fitted M.2 PCIe SSD; no installed drive or exact position is asserted by the family model.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing coin-cell battery
sources.locator: Press battery-socket release latch; remove the coin-cell battery
sources.notes: Dell warns that battery removal may reset BIOS/settings. Fitted manufacturer and exact battery variant remain unknown.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing heatsink fan
sources.locator: Disconnect heatsink assembly cable; remove fan screws through top screw holes; lift fan away
sources.notes: Exact fan part number and screw-head geometry are not identified by the family package.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower installing optical drive
sources.locator: Slide the optional optical drive into the bay until it clicks; route cables under the drive cage and connect data/power
sources.notes: Optional slim optical drive and routing observation only; not evidence that an ODD is fitted.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower installing optional VGA module
sources.locator: Release rear metal blanking bracket, insert optional video module from inside, connect cable and secure with two M3×3 screws
sources.notes: VGA/HDMI/DisplayPort/Type-C module is optional and configuration-dependent; not asserted as fitted.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing 3.5-inch hard-drive assembly
sources.locator: Disconnect SATA and power, remove HDD filler bracket, press blue tab and pull assembly
sources.notes: Optional 3.5-inch storage carrier. Exact fitted drive and cage configuration remain unknown.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing 3.5-inch drive from bracket
sources.locator: Pull one side of the HDD bracket to disengage pins from drive slots, then lift drive out
sources.notes: Documents a flexible pin retention method rather than a universal screw pattern.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing 2.5-inch hard-drive assembly
sources.locator: Disconnect drive data/power, press blue tabs on both sides, pull assembly out
sources.notes: Separate removable 2.5-inch assembly; optional fitted population remains unknown.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing 2.5-inch drive from bracket
sources.locator: Pull one side of the bracket to disengage its pins from drive slots, then lift drive out
sources.notes: Documents pin-based drive retention; the package does not invent dimensions or screw positions.

sources.title: Dell OptiPlex 5060 Tower removing optical drive
sources.locator: Disconnect ODD data/power, unroute cables from tabs under drive cage, press blue release tab and slide drive out
sources.notes: Slim ODD option is not asserted as fitted. Cable retention tabs are represented as a semantic group only.
